europe_now.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute
europe_now.summary: Spain implemented border checks on Italian travelers due to a migrant dispute, escalating tensions between the two EU countries. The measures reflect ongoing challenges in EU border management.
